Impressum und Datenschutzerklärung sind: A legal notice and a privacy policy are mandatory for a shop selling commercially — and they must be findable in the footer. As long as they're missing, no link appears there: a link leading nowhere looks as if the duty were fulfilled.
Weil hier auch Privatkunden ohne MwSt.-N: Because private customers without a VAT number also order here — farmers, households — consumer law applies as well: withdrawal information and consumer warranty. Incomplete withdrawal information extends the period from fourteen days to twelve months and fourteen days. This page is therefore the one that deserves the most thorough review.
Er legt die fehlenden Seiten als Entwurf: It creates the missing pages as drafts, with a scaffold and marked gaps. It publishes nothing and overwrites nothing. The text is not a finished legal text — the details must be filled in and the content reviewed by someone who knows the law.
Für die Datenschutzerklärung hält WordPr: For the privacy policy, WordPress itself provides a detailed draft — under %s. WooCommerce and other plugins add their sections there too, for example on accounts, orders and payment. That text is a better basis than any outside template because it describes what actually runs on this installation.

Warenkorb, Kasse und Konto übersetzt Woo: Cart, checkout and account are translated by WooCommerce itself — as soon as the language packs are installed. That happens under Settings → General → Site Language: choose "Italiano" once and save, choose "English (UK)" once and save, then switch back to German. With every switch WordPress downloads the packs for all plugins and keeps them.
